title: Inspect before acting
prompt: You entered a repository. Check its branch, staged changes, unstaged changes, and untracked files.
why: Shows the index and working tree relative to HEAD so you can choose the next operation.
verify: Read the staged, unstaged, and untracked sections; git status --short gives a compact view.
hint: Start with the repository state.

title: Review unstaged edits
prompt: Review tracked edits that are not staged yet.
why: Compares the working tree to the index; it does not include untracked file contents.
verify: The patch should contain only the unstaged edits you expect.
hint: Compare working tree and index.

title: Stage selected hunks
prompt: reports.txt has two unrelated edits. Stage just the relevant hunks.
why: Interactive patch staging lets one commit express one intent.
verify: git diff --staged shows selected hunks; git diff shows what remains.
hint: Use interactive patch mode.

title: Review the next commit
prompt: See exactly which tracked changes your next ordinary commit will contain.
why: Compares the index to HEAD, which is the content an ordinary git commit records.
verify: Review every hunk, then use git status to confirm the staged file list.
hint: Compare index and HEAD.

title: Unstage without losing work
prompt: reports.txt was staged accidentally. Keep the edit but remove it from the index.
why: Restores the index from HEAD without changing the working file.
verify: git diff --staged reports.txt is empty; git diff reports.txt still shows your edit.
hint: Restore only the index.

title: Describe a feature commit
prompt: Staged changes add report filters. Commit them using Conventional Commits.
why: A type and concise description communicate intent; feat describes new behavior.
verify: git log -1 --format=%s and git show --stat HEAD confirm the message and files.
hint: Use type: description.

title: Isolate a feature
prompt: From main, create and switch to feat/filters.
why: A branch moves with new commits and isolates the feature history.
verify: git branch --show-current prints feat/filters.
hint: Create while switching.

title: Parallel checkout
prompt: Keep your current checkout intact and open feat/docs in a new sibling directory ../docs. That branch does not exist yet.
why: A linked worktree has its own working files and index while sharing objects and refs.
verify: git worktree list shows both paths; git -C ../docs branch --show-current prints feat/docs.
hint: Add a worktree and a new branch.

title: Remove a finished checkout
prompt: The linked worktree ../docs is clean and finished. Remove it safely.
why: Removes the linked checkout and registration; it leaves the branch available.
verify: git worktree list no longer includes ../docs; git branch still lists feat/docs.
hint: Use worktree remove; do not force a dirty checkout.

title: Refresh remote knowledge
prompt: Update your view of origin without merging into the current branch.
why: Downloads objects and updates remote-tracking refs without integrating them into your branch.
verify: git log --oneline --decorate --all shows updated origin refs.
hint: Fetch first; integration is a separate decision.

title: Replay a private feature
prompt: Your feature branch is private, the working tree is clean, and you just fetched origin. Replay your commits on origin/main.
why: Replays feature commits over the fetched base, producing new commit IDs.
verify: git status is clean; git log --graph --oneline --all shows the new base.
hint: Rebase onto the fetched remote-tracking branch.
caution: Rewrite only history you own, coordinate with collaborators, and keep a backup branch before rewriting. Never use an unconditional force push.

title: Continue a resolved rebase
prompt: A rebase stopped on reports.txt. You edited the file, removed conflict markers, and tested the resolution. What next?
why: Staging records the resolution; continue resumes replay. Repeat if later commits conflict.
verify: git status reports progress or a clean finished branch; inspect and test the final result.
hint: Stage the resolved file before continuing.

title: Abandon a rebase
prompt: A rebase is in progress and you want to return to its starting state.
why: Cancels the rebase and restores the original branch state.
verify: git status no longer reports a rebase; git log shows the original branch tip.
hint: Abort the operation, not just the conflicted file.

title: Publish rewritten history carefully
prompt: You rebased your own already-published feat/filters branch. You reviewed origin/feat/filters and recorded its exact old commit ID as OLD_SHA. Show a push that refuses to replace any other tip.
why: An explicit expected old tip rejects the push if the remote branch changed, including changes hidden by a background fetch.
verify: Check the push result, then git fetch origin and compare git rev-parse feat/filters origin/feat/filters.
hint: Use a lease with the reviewed expected commit ID.
caution: Rewrite only history you own, coordinate with collaborators, and keep a backup branch before rewriting. Never use an unconditional force push.

title: Clean up local history
prompt: Your private branch has exactly three feature commits after its base. Combine them before review.
why: Keep the first commit as pick and mark the next two squash (or fixup to discard their messages). This rewrites the commits.
verify: git log --oneline shows one feature commit; compare the final files with a backup branch and run tests.
hint: Open the last three commits in the rebase todo list.
caution: Rewrite only history you own, coordinate with collaborators, and keep a backup branch before rewriting. Never use an unconditional force push.

title: Create a dependent branch
prompt: You are on feat/api and the next feature needs those unmerged changes. Start feat/ui on this tip.
why: The child inherits the parent commits. When publishing, target the UI PR at feat/api so its diff contains only UI work.
verify: git log --graph --oneline --all shows the shared parent; git diff feat/api...feat/ui starts empty.
hint: Branch from the parent, not main.

title: Restack after a squash merge
prompt: feat/ui contains UI commits after the original feat/api tip. feat/api was squash-merged to main. You fetched origin and kept feat/api at its ORIGINAL tip. Replay only UI commits onto origin/main.
why: Excludes commits reachable from the old parent and replays the child-only commits on the new base. Retarget the UI PR to main afterward.
verify: git log origin/main..feat/ui contains only UI commits; git diff origin/main...feat/ui shows only UI changes; run tests.
hint: Use --onto with the new base, old parent tip, and child branch.
caution: Rewrite only history you own, coordinate with collaborators, and keep a backup branch before rewriting. Never use an unconditional force push.

title: Find a lost local tip
prompt: A local branch was moved and you need to find its previous commit ID.
why: Records local ref movements, including commits no longer reachable from branches. Entries expire and are not a remote backup.
verify: Find the expected message and inspect its hash with git show before recovering.
hint: Look at the local ref movement log.

title: Keep a recovered commit
prompt: You inspected a lost commit and its hash is abc1234. Preserve it without changing the current checkout.
why: A new branch makes the commit reachable while leaving your working tree untouched.
verify: git show rescue and git branch --show-current confirm recovery and the unchanged checkout.
hint: Name a branch at the inspected commit.

title: Repair the latest private message
prompt: Your most recent commit is private and its message should be fix: handle empty filters. Change only its message; assume the index has no staged edits.
why: Amend replaces the last commit, so its ID changes. A clean index prevents unrelated staged changes from being included.
verify: git log -1 --format=%s confirms the message; git diff HEAD@{1} HEAD should be empty.
hint: Amend the last commit with a new message.
caution: Rewrite only history you own, coordinate with collaborators, and keep a backup branch before rewriting. Never use an unconditional force push.
